picks.name: Actress
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Ninja Tune. Experimental/IDM-adjacent electronic territory connected to your Klara Lewis and Loraine James picks.
picks.bio: "Radical Frame" (September 18, 2026, Ninja Tune) is Darren Cunningham's eighth album as Actress -- eight tracks of fractured, abstract electronics featuring CASISDEAD on "Live By You" and Rainy Miller on the 16-minute closer "Sheets," his first full-length for the label since 2023's "LXXXVIII."
picks.why_listen: Warped, abstracted techno and IDM from one of the UK's most singular electronic producers -- dense, strange material for a headier stretch of a set.
